The file defines a single source for the `runitor` package, specifying that it should track git tags from the official GitHub repository `https://github.com/bdd/runitor.git`. The configuration includes a regex filter `^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$` to match only version tags in the format `vX.Y.Z`, which is a standard practice to avoid tracking irrelevant branches or malformed tags.

There is no executable code, network request outside of expected version checking, or suspicious operations in this file. It does not perform downloads, execute external commands, or modify system state. The use of `git` as a source and filtering via `include_regex` is consistent with normal `nvchecker` usage in AUR or packaging workflows to automate version updates. The upstream source is the legitimate project repository, and no obfuscation or malicious redirection is present.

This file poses no security risk and aligns with standard packaging hygiene for version monitoring.
</details>
